source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بوسط أرض جدي، كان في شجرة زيتون كبيرة وقديمة.
sentences.en: In the middle of my grandfather's land, there was a big, old olive tree.

sentences.ar: جدي كان يقول إنها أكبر منه بكتير.
sentences.en: My grandfather used to say it was much older than him.

sentences.ar: كل خريف، كانت العيلة كلها تجتمع تحتها لتقطف.
sentences.en: Every fall, the whole family would gather under it to harvest.

sentences.ar: لما كنت صغير، سألت جدي: ليش هالشجرة مهمة هيك؟
sentences.en: When I was little, I asked my grandfather: why is this tree so important?

sentences.ar: ابتسم وقال: هاي الشجرة زرعها أبو جدي بإيده.
sentences.en: He smiled and said: this tree was planted by my great-grandfather with his own hands.

sentences.ar: قال إنها شافت أجيال وأجيال من عيلتنا.
sentences.en: He said it had seen generations upon generations of our family.

sentences.ar: كل غصن فيها بيحكي قصة، وكل زيتونة فيها بركة.
sentences.en: Every branch in it tells a story, and every olive in it is a blessing.

sentences.ar: مرة، إجا رجال وعرض يشتري الأرض والشجرة.
sentences.en: Once, a man came and offered to buy the land and the tree.

sentences.ar: عرض مصاري كتير، بس جدي رفض على طول.
sentences.en: He offered a lot of money, but my grandfather refused right away.

sentences.ar: قال: الأرض مش للبيع، والذكريات ما إلها تمن.
sentences.en: He said: the land is not for sale, and memories have no price.

sentences.ar: بعد سنين، توفى جدي، وورثنا الأرض والشجرة.
sentences.en: After years, my grandfather passed away, and we inherited the land and the tree.

sentences.ar: وقفت تحت الشجرة وحسيت إنه جدي لسا معي.
sentences.en: I stood under the tree and felt my grandfather was still with me.

sentences.ar: علمت ولادي نفس الشي اللي علمني ياه.
sentences.en: I taught my children the same thing he taught me.

sentences.ar: الشجرة ما زالت واقفة، تشهد على محبتنا للأرض.
sentences.en: The tree is still standing, a witness to our love for the land.

sentences.ar: وكل خريف، بنجتمع تحتها متل زمان.
sentences.en: And every fall, we gather under it like the old days.
